logistics.format: Two-phase exam: knowledge-based written exam (proctored) plus practical scenario-based incident response examination using EnCase Endpoint Investigator; 3 years validity

recommended_certs.rationale: CFSR builds on the same EnCase tooling as EnCE; analysts often hold EnCE first.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded practical incident scenario plus proctored knowledge assessment support professional forensic-response delivery despite the two-year profile; EnCase lock-in and limited recognition constrain portability.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: A proctored knowledge phase plus scenario-based incident-response practical supports professional response work with a two-year profile. EnCase dependence and limited independent recognition constrain portability across MSSP client tooling.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded practical incident-response scenario adds direct delivery evidence to the written examination. That supports professional response work despite a two-year profile, with EnCase dependence limiting portability.
